title: Signed-sum classification
description: The registered model reads two real inputs x = (x0, x1) and returns logits for two classes; its prediction is the class with the larger logit. It should predict class 1 when x0 + x1 > 0 and class 0 otherwise. Using only the permitted inspection and editing operations, produce a candidate checkpoint that follows this rule, and select it.
output_description: logits for class 0 and class 1; the predicted class is the argmax

objective.description: Predict class 1 exactly when x0 + x1 > 0, measured as accuracy on the development suite.
